title: Bear's Head

[[Image:Bear's Head.jpg|thumb|Bear's Head]]

'''Bear's Head''' is a remote [[subzone]] located by the southeastern edge of the mountains of [[Azshara]]. [[Azshara Tower]], located on a cliff in the area, houses [[Archmage Xylem]] as well as several apprentices and associates, including the high elves [[Joy Ar'nareth]] and [[Rayan Dawnrisen]].

The area is named after the [[village]]s of [[Timbermaw]] [[furbolg]]s dotting the landscape, which work as outposts for the more northerly [[Timbermaw Hold]] and [[Ursolan]].
